title: Balochistan Prohibition of Public Meetings On Public Thoroughfares Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Prohibition of Public Meetings On Public Thoroughfares Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 2001
ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
PROHIBITION OF PUBLIC MEETINGS
(ON PUBLIC
THOROUGHFARES) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
Ana Ordinance to
amend the Balochistan Prohibition of
Public Meetings (on
Public Thoroughfares) Act, 1973.
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
30th October, 2001]
No.Legis.2‑42/Law/79/IV,
dated 30‑10‑2001.----The following Ordinance made by the Governor
of Balochistan on 27th October, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Balochistan Prohibition of Public Meetings (on Public Thoroughfares)
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2001. .
(2) It shall come into force on
the 14th, day of August, 2001.

Amendment of section 2 of Act XI of 1973

ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 2001
ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
PROHIBITION OF PUBLIC MEETINGS
(ON PUBLIC
THOROUGHFARES) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
Ana Ordinance to
amend the Balochistan Prohibition of
Public Meetings (on
Public Thoroughfares) Act, 1973.
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
30th October, 2001]
No.Legis.2‑42/Law/79/IV,
dated 30‑10‑2001.----The following Ordinance made by the Governor
of Balochistan on 27th October, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 2 of
Act XI of 1973.‑‑‑In the Balochistan Prohibition of
Public Meetings (on Public Thoroughfares) Act, 1973, hereinafter referred to as
the said Act in section 2,‑‑
(a) clause (a) shall be deleted.
(b) after clause (e) the
following new clause shall be inserted:‑
"(f)
"Zila Nazim" means the Zila Nazim as defined in the Local Government
Ordinance, 2001 (XVIII of 2001).
